facebook.caption: Phu Quoc doesn't feel like Phu Quoc up here. Fifth floor, open air, the sun dropping straight into the sea. Greek food. Cold wine. Zero resort crowds. The Greek Restaurant Phu Quoc sits above 124 Đường Trần Hưng Đạo and the rooftop view alone is worth the climb. 4.8 stars across 76 reviews. Budget $15-30 per person. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
